art: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for dark gothic PSP deckbuilding game Rift Ascent, not a UI mockup. Create ONE transparent-background 3 columns x 3 rows atlas, 1536x1536. Each evenly spaced square cell 512x512 has a single centered fully visible painted object with 50px empty margin. No words, no numbers, no UI border, no stray circles or glyphs. Detailed oil-painted dark gothic wrought iron, aged bone, oxblood cloth and subtle ember/gold highlights, tangible readable silhouettes at 64px. Top row left: an ancient open stone sarcophagus with a ghostly duplicate sword emerging (Echo Crypt). Top middle: a heavy black iron anvil with a red hot blade and cold shield (Black Anvil). Top right: an open charred grimoire with a burning quill (Cinder Scriptorium). Middle row left: a cathedral reliquary cabinet with a small amber sacred object and gold coins (Reliquary Auction). Middle center: gloved skeletal merchant hand holding two cards and silver scissors (Warden's Bargain). Middle right: gothic black iron hourglass filled with glowing embers, distinct complete artifact (Ashen Hourglass relic). Bottom left: a small aged bone funeral bell with a dark iron handle (Ossuary Bell relic). Bottom middle: a long tarnished silver sewing needle and one loop of blood red thread (Penitent's Needle relic). Bottom right: crossed short sword and small shield bound together by a pale ribbon (Duelist's Reliquary relic). Consistent lighting, sepia and charcoal shadows, avoid colorful cartoon style. Each isolated object stays inside its own cell, no connecting elements. Truly transparent alpha backdrop.
seal: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for the dark gothic PSP card game Rift Ascent. A 3-column 2-row grid of SIX large fully isolated circular wax-and-metal seals, one centered in each cell, equal size. Canvas 1536x1024. No text, letters, numerals, extra objects or background. Each seal is a tangible sculpted gothic artifact with a bold SIMPLE high contrast embossed pictogram readable at only 16 pixels. Edge is a thick aged metal lip, interior slightly irregular wax. Top left: violet-black wax with two bright ivory swords (ECHO). Top center: deep emerald wax with a pale closed padlock (BOUND/RETAIN). Top right: dark crimson wax with one bright broad sword blade (KEEN damage). Bottom left: dark steel blue wax with a large ivory medieval shield (WARD block). Bottom center: burnt amber wax with one dark skull, ivory highlights (FLEETING exhaust and discount). Bottom right: burgundy wax with a bright ivory open book and small amber flame (KINDLED draw and exhaust). Restrained dark gothic painted realism, strongest contrast in central simple pictogram, clear outer silhouette, no filigree clutter inside. Complete objects, 60px margins within each 512px cell, actual transparent alpha.
enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite atlas for Rift Ascent, dark gothic painted fantasy game, transparent alpha. One 4-column by 2-row sheet, 2048x1024, each cell512x512. Eight distinct FULL BODY grounded monsters, all in three-quarter side view facing LEFT toward a player on the left, ready stance with feet at the bottom. Each complete figure AND weapon wholly within its cell with 40px empty margin. No backdrop, no floor shadow, no interface, no words, no glowing circles, no abstract colored lines. High contrast ivory/tarnished metal faces and edges, charcoals and deep crimson, polished painterly realism readable at 100px tall, dark menacing gothic silhouettes. Top row left to right: (1) Gallows Stalker: gaunt undead hangman in ragged brown executioner's hood, noose draped over shoulder, holding a short hooked scythe forward to LEFT; (2) Candle Wretch: hunched faceless wax-covered humanoid with small candles growing from shoulders, one long bone claw extended left, no large flames; (3) Sepulcher Guard: stocky coffin-armored knight, heavy stone shield and a crushing iron mace held forward left; (4) Thorn Penitent: narrow masked cultist wearing dark red penitential robes and thorn chains, holding a wicked flail extended left. Bottom row left to right: (5) Veil Duelist: elegant pale porcelain masked duelist in torn black velvet, thin saber pointed left, boots firmly visible; (6) Tomb Cantor: skeletal cathedral chorister in aged ivory vestments holding a skull-topped staff pointing left; (7) Oathless Lancer: tall formidable black-armored knight, skull visor, long broken lance held diagonal toward upper left, fully fits the cell; (8) Cathedral Horror: hulking grotesque of cathedral stone and exposed bone with two massive claw arms, gargoyle head facing left, powerful legs, no wings. Every enemy grounded with two clear feet, all facing left, no floating orbs, each separate and complete. Actual transparent background.
cards: Use case: stylized-concept. Four original dark gothic fantasy collectible card illustrations as ONE exact 2x2 grid atlas 1536x1024, each cell landscape768x512, painted cinematic realism, opaque scenes, no frames, text, lettering or UI. High detail and strong central subjects, camera framed so each action is readable even in a wide horizontal crop through the UPPER THIRD of each image. Same mysterious ruined cathedral world, antique steel, charcoals, blood red and candle amber. Top left GRAVE CLEAVER: a massive heavy broadsword cleaves into an undead knight's raised stone-and-iron shield, cracking it, forceful blade at a diagonal and shard fragments, dominant sword and shattered shield centered high. Top right DUSK GUARD: a dark armored warden braces a broad ornate shield while phantom blades hit it, blue moonlight and pale impact dust, upper shield is central high. Bottom left MERCY'S EDGE: a silver saber cuts a binding red thread from a kneeling wounded dark knight's shoulder while pale healing embers drift toward the wielder, sharp weapon and masked face high in frame, restrained non-graphic. Bottom right BLACK COVENANT: a dark armored hand holds an hourglass of ember light before an ancient crypt altar, two small ritual candles, fiery particles flow outward, hourglass centered in upper half. Serious dark gothic art, not cartoon, no arbitrary lines, no decorative rune circles. Four clearly distinct compositions separated only by exact grid boundaries, fill each cell edge to edge.
